Game Overview

Save the Sea is a educational title where dive into Save the Sea and embark on a thrilling mission to cleanse the ocean. Navigate through increasingly challenging levels, collecting trash while dodging obstacles and sea creatures. With captivating visuals and a focus on environmental consciousness, this engaging adventure tests your quick reflexes and strategic skill.
